3000-3510-4288-4875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3000-3510-4288-4875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

147-5100-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5100-8095.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

2105-3337--140.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-3337--140.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker and exert it, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an extra combat.
Repeat.

1429-3545-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1349-5239-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-5239-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

553-2928-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Tidal Barracuda.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima the Impostor and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1526-3457-7791.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Circle of Dreams Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6823-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6823-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3259-4053-4742-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-4742-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-4742-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

2082-2829-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-2829-3490-7426.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat

3490-4506-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4506-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

141-5188-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5188-6797.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1350-4010-6723-7296.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-7296.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1734-2921-3175.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1692-2489-3732-4823.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3732-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3732-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness with haste.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

1651-2499-3875-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-3875-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-3875-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-3581-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-3581-5078-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten and Kykar triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

141-3967-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3967-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

4381-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

5200-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 4 or greater.
5200-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
5200-6478.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2556-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2556-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Mnemonic Wall and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Mnemonic Wall, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1753-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1753-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

67-2525-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-3385-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-3385-5434.description:
Cast Ashcloud Phoenix by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to it.
Ashcloud Phoenix dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Ashcloud Phoenix's first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield face-down, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to it.
Ashcloud Phoenix dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, and then turning it face-up.
Aether Flash and Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashcloud Phoenix trigger, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Aether Flash trigger, dealing 2 damage to Ashcloud Phoenix.
Repeat from step 3.

578-4222-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-4222-4758.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

643-717-4035-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Blood Speaker.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token that enters the battlefield as a Demon due to Maskwood Nexus.
Blood Speaker's second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, land or creature.
Repeat.

864-877-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Eternal Witness dies, Saffi triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saffi by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Repeat.

364-1987-2556-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
